title: Deliverable pack manifest (manifest.json at archive root)
description: Self-description of a deliverable pack (FR-009). One entry per contained file, manifest.json excepted. 'record' entries carry the sha256 stored on the artifact row, so every file is checkable against the run's audit trail (SC-004); derived files are hashed at assembly.

run_id.description: The run this pack was assembled from.

generated_at.description: Assembly time, UTC ISO 8601. The pack is assembled per request and never stored; this stamps the request.

files.description: Every file in the archive except manifest.json itself. Empty for a run that has produced no artifacts — an accurate empty manifest, never an error.

archive_path.description: Path of the file inside the archive, e.g. 'deliverables/copy.json' or 'flagged/video_props.violations.json'.

kind.description: The artifact kind this file belongs to (copy, posts, email, video_props, site, video, video_vertical — or any future kind; the set is the system's, not this schema's).

role.description: record: the stored artifact bytes verbatim. companion: mechanical human-readable rendering of a structured record (FR-011). violations: the flagged record's itemised violations.

revision.description: Revision of the artifact this file was produced from — the latest for its kind at assembly time.

grounding_status.description: The artifact's grounding status. Anything other than 'clean' places the file under flagged/ (FR-010).

content_type.description: MIME type of this file: the artifact's stored content_type for records; text/markdown for companions; application/json for violations.

sha256.description: For role=record, copied from the artifact row — hashing the extracted file must reproduce it. For derived roles, computed over the emitted bytes at assembly.
